status: execution-lock manifest; not a replacement normative register
true_substitute_rule: A repair must pass the frozen negative and positive/boundary controls under the same declared resource/authority boundary without implementing an operationally equivalent form of the removed invariant.

principles.invariant: Evidence may support a receiving decision only for the proposition it sufficiently establishes; insufficient or residual state must not be silently promoted.
principles.negative_control: matched-source/issuer/record-class valid evidence supports a narrower proposition than the rights-enforcement decision requires
principles.positive_control: same source/issuer/record-class carries evidence that actually supports the enforcement proposition
known_confounds: original naive A1 pair changed issuer/source and record class as well as semantic proposition; source-authority-only is a TRUE SUBSTITUTE for that naive pair
corrected A1 matched-semantic isolation freezes nonsemantic observables and varies only proposition sufficiency

principles.invariant: Unresolved determination effort must be finite, decision-relevant and bounded by available capacity/response horizon, with an explicit bounded fallback.
principles.negative_control: matched-prefix unresolved determination remains non-resolving through the declared useful horizon
principles.positive_control: same observed prefix resolves exactly at an allowed horizon step
known_confounds: fixed early timeout can appear safe on the negative branch but destroys a still-reachable positive resolution
external scheduler, circuit breaker, parallel budget or bounded probe may move P2 outside the component but still reconstruct the system-level invariant

principles.invariant: Known unresolved material state must not be converted into permission, PASS or certainty-equivalent closure.
principles.negative_control: matched-authority/confidence/freshness corridor postures remain materially incompatible without an explicit HOLD marker
principles.positive_control: uniform determinate NORMAL and PLAN_A states remain executable
known_confounds: original base conflict included a literal HOLD posture; a HOLD-marker veto is a TRUE SUBSTITUTE for that naive base pair
corrected matched-conflict isolation removes HOLD and equalizes authority/confidence/freshness

principles.invariant: The relying decision must retain or obtain a current, receiver-verifiable authority qualification sufficient for the actual composed action and non-amplification boundary. Preserved root/delegation lineage is one implementation; authoritative scoped attestation/capability is another.
principles.negative_control: Branch U unauthorized common-root campaign with locally valid leaf grants
principles.positive_control: Branch G current root-authorized campaign plus Branch I independent cases
known_confounds: rate/volume/risk/static allow-list controls cannot separate matched U/G and may become deny-all
full historical delegation lineage is not necessary in 00H if a legitimate owner-side PDP or scoped capability returns a current decision-sufficient permit
00H supports the minimal authority-qualification/non-amplification invariant, not universal receiver-side possession of full lineage history

principles.invariant: A prior determination is reusable at actuation only while its declared material decision basis remains current; material mismatch reopens qualification.
principles.negative_control: queued action remains technically valid after material basis change
known_confounds: generation-only compare is a partial repair and misses incident-only, freeze-only and source/policy-version-only changes
queue age/TTL cannot distinguish same-age continuity and stale semantic state
cancel-on-any-event catches material change only by also invalidating irrelevant events unless event semantics are mapped to the declared material basis
compressed state hash/version vector/epoch are valid implementations only if they cover the full declared material basis

principles.invariant: Locally valid or repeated determinations must not be promoted to ecosystem truth or silently substituted across principals/domains without explicit dependency, independence or compatibility composition.
principles.positive_control: matched-authority materially independent support for legitimate transition
known_confounds: unmodified 00G F/G changes both source independence and transition authority; A6a finds an authority-only TRUE SUBSTITUTE for that naive pair
counting distinct immediate source IDs is a partial implementation because apparently distinct sources may share a transitive material root
hardened A6 equalizes identities, organizations, immediate source count, signatures, freshness, confidence, timing and content diversity while varying only transitive dependency
